page.title: New agent
page.purpose: Describe an agent in plain language and get a complete drafted profile back to confirm. The draft is always presented before anything is written, and the write goes through a typed action rather than a free-form model write.

priorities.statement: That a plain description is enough, and nothing else is required to start
Exactly what will be written, before it is written
Which capabilities the draft proposes, and that they are editable before saving
That the draft can be discarded without leaving residue

states.description: An empty description field and one dominant action.
The description is being drafted; the action is busy.
A complete draft is shown for confirmation, with every field editable.
The description cannot be drafted from; the message sits beside the field.
Drafting failed; the description is preserved and retry is offered.
The confirmed draft is being written through the typed action.
The signed-in person may not create agents.
Assisted drafting is unavailable; manual authoring still works.
The page's regions are resolving; each reports its own placeholder.
Nothing to show yet; the surface says so and offers the action that would fill it.
One region failed while the rest resolved; the failure is named and the page stays usable.
Content is from a cached read; its age is stated.

claims.statement: The drafted profile is presented for confirmation and no agent exists until the confirm action is used.
Every field in the draft is editable before confirming, including the proposed capabilities.
claims.rationale: A draft that can only be accepted or rejected wholesale gets accepted wholesale.

claims.statement: The proposed capability set never includes an owner-only capability by default.
A failed draft preserves the typed description verbatim.
A manual authoring path is available and does not depend on the drafting service.
claims.rationale: Assisted authoring is a convenience; it must never be the only way to create an agent.

claims.statement: Discarding a draft leaves no partially-written agent behind.
Exactly one action dominates in each of the default and success states.
The draft preview holds its hierarchy in both themes.
